newsitem.title: UK: R.S. Platou Shipbrokers and Orkla Finans in alliance.
newsitem.headline: R.S. Platou Shipbrokers and Orkla Finans in alliance.

text.p: Norwegian investment bank Orkla Finans and shipbroking group R.S. Platou Shipbrokers said Monday they are forming a co-operative alliance in the shipping and offshore sectors.
The two groups said the alliance would be effective immediately and would yield significant synergies.
They said: "Orkla Finans will have access to R.S. Platou Shipbrokers' analysis, research, estimates and market data."
Resources from both companies will be shared, they added, and that the agreement includes co-operation on joint corporate finance activities.
R.S. Platou said it has been seeking a partner from among Norway's investment banks since the closure of R.S. Platou Securities earlier this year.

The Norwegian arm of Swedish bank Handelsbanken took over the Platou brokerage services company in April after the Oslo authorities withdrew part of its licence to operate following a share issue scandal.
Orkla Finans said the alliance would strengthen its position and increase its market share in the shipping/offshore sector. -Paul Berrill Reuters Shipping News + 44 171 542 4087. Fax 5017.
